title: More brains for your business: QuickBooks, backed by Intuit Intelligence
summary: Intuit’s ‘More Brains for Your Business’ campaign shows how QuickBooks and Intuit Intelligence combine AI, accountants, and your data to help owners do more.
body_markdown:
## *"If only I had another me."*


Talk to business owners of any size and you’ll hear some version of the same wish: “If only I had another me.” Intuit’s new campaign, “More Brains for Your Business,” launched November 16 and starts from that wish. No one can clone themselves, but QuickBooks, backed by Intuit Intelligence, can put more brainpower behind every business.


Intuit Intelligence is the AI built into the Intuit platform, bringing together advanced AI, 650,000 accountants, and the business’s own data to help take owners from data to decision to done. The anthem film is set to 8x GRAMMY award winning musician and composer Jon Batiste’s reimagining of “If I Only Had a Brain.” and the work runs across TV and streaming, NFL and live sports, audio, social, digital and creators.


## If only I had another me


Ask a business owner what’s on their mind, and the answer is usually everything. The invoice that’s 30 days late. The receipts piling up. Whether this morning’s quote was priced too low. Whether this is the year to hire. Owners carry all of it, often across tools that don’t talk to each other, and they second guess the small decisions along with the big ones. The more a business grows, the more stretched its owner gets.


When Intuit talked with owners for this campaign, from solo operators to companies with millions in revenue, the same line kept coming up: “If only I had another me.” What they described was someone to share the load. They wanted someone to keep the books straight, flag what needs attention, and help them figure out what to do next, while they stay in charge of the business they built.


That’s what “More Brains for Your Business” sets out to give them.


“Intuit Intelligence is how we’re building one platform where


[AI and human intelligence](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/r/artificial-intelligence/) work together,” said Thomas Ranese, chief marketing officer for Intuit. “Business owners don’t want AI hype or tools that try to replace their judgment. They want time back, work that’s done for you and done right, and the confidence to make their next big move. ‘More Brains for Your Business’ makes that easy to picture.”


## More brains, working together


Intuit Intelligence brings three kinds of intelligence to bear on the same business:


- **Financial AI:** Trained on decades of data from millions of businesses, it helps handle the busywork in the background.


- **Human experts:** 650,000 accountants using the Intuit platform bring context and judgement that AI can’t.


- **The business’s own data:** Sales, team and financial numbers sit in one place, so both the AI and the accountant work from the full picture.


Day to day, that help goes to the owners who are used to staying up late to get their work done. Intuit Intelligence categorizes transactions as they come in, so owners start each month with more accurate books instead of a pile to sort through. It keeps income and expenses current, so owners know what to charge before they send the next quote. It flags overdue invoices and drafts the reminders; customers using Intuit Intelligence invoice reminders get paid an average of 4 days faster.


1 It also turns the same data into projections an owner can plan around, such as a hire or an expansion.


[Customers say they save an average of 13 hours a month](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/intuit-intelligence/) and


[reduce manual work by 30%](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/r/product-update/intuit-intelligence-new-features/) . More brains means more help with the thinking. The final call stays with the person who runs the business.
